You snap your wrist sideways, sending a gust across the shaft just as it flies toward your companion.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self or one visible willing ally within 3 squares, before a defense roll against a physical projectile attack.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Defense

Grant 1 Boon to this defense. This cannot affect an area attack or a projectile larger than the target’s footprint. Use the existing defense roll.
